description: International shipments introduce a five-second checkout delay.

incident.title: Checkout is slow for customers with international addresses
incident.description: Customers shipping outside the United States report much slower checkout, while US-address orders appear normal. Requests may still succeed. Investigate the source of the latency.

diagnostic_reference.observable_mechanism: The logged international-shipment path introduces approximately five seconds of delay; observations associate the delay with intlShippingSlowdown.
diagnostic_reference.propagation: A linked checkout request inherits the shipping fulfillment delay and can still succeed.
exclusions: Do not substitute get-quote latency for ship-order latency.
Do not generalize a bounded sample to every foreign or US request. Exact destination or variant claims need retained observations.
